rdfs:label: serviceEndpoint
rdfs:comment: On a DID document service entry (did:Service), the endpoint(s) where the service is reachable — a URI, a map, or a set of these.
notes: A DID Document carries `service` entries (messaging endpoints, profile servers, credential exchange endpoints); each one carries one or more `serviceEndpoint` URLs. Distinct from DCAT's `dcat:endpointURL` (data-service flavour) — same general idea, different domain vocabulary. Upstream `rdfs:domain` is `did:Service` (the service entry), not the DID document itself. Service `type` values such as `DIDCommMessaging` or `LinkedDomains` come from the DID Specification Registries, not the `did:` vocabulary.

examples.title: A service endpoint on a DID

history.note: Example service type changed to did:Service (DIDCommMessaging is not in the did: vocabulary); comment allows URI/map/set values; notes give upstream domain did:Service.
